### Limitations

- Sample sizes above; no winner is declared below n=3 per group or without two groups.
- Manual posts (posted by the owner outside the studio) are listed with their metrics but excluded from the comparisons above: they did not pass brand review and their creative is not on record.
- Attribution: metrics come from Metricool's Instagram/Facebook analytics for organic posts; DM keyword hits are not tracked until comment-to-DM exists; follows are per-post as reported by the network.
- Posts differ in publish time, creative, caption language and day; differences are descriptive, not causal.
- Instagram "impressions" and "video views" fields are deprecated at Metricool and are not collected.

### Recommended next tests

- Fill the smallest groups first (see the comparison notes) before changing the mix; keep one variable per test (format or language), not both.
